record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare GUILLOTINE in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, stats and the caster's current ATK.
record.summary: Single-target special damage equal to the caster's current ATK x 3 (x 6 at 4 stars); if that hit kills the target (death flag), the caster gains half of its maxPP.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

declaredRaw.unit: multiplier of the caster's current ATK

effects.scaling: raw = pokemon.atk (the current ATK at cast time, buffs and debuffs included) x multiplier; then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested = ATK x multiplier. applied = after AP/crit, the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; the amount first fills the target's shield. A protect / skydiving / magicBounce target takes none. The strategy ignores takenDamage and reads only the death flag.

effects.target: the caster, only if the hit returned death
effects.scaling: baseValue = 0.5 x maxPP; apBoost 0 and crit false are passed, so neither AP nor crit scales it; halved again if the caster has fatigue
effects.resolution: requested = 0.5 x maxPP; applied = round of the fatigue-adjusted value, refused if the caster is silenced, protected, has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting, and the result is clamped to 2 x maxPP - 1. Super.process already set pp to max(0, pp - maxPP) before this gain.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (6, also the fallback) is not reachable by the four units' bare star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast reads the caster's ATK at that moment.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage = current ATK x 3 (x 6 at 4 stars), not a fixed number. Dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and shield first. The PP reward is 0.5 x maxPP before fatigue and the clamp. Death means hp <= 0 without resurrection; when a Cover Band ally redirects the hit, the death flag returned is the cover ally's, not the target's.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items such as Poke Doll, synergy effects, damage-reduction effects, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL SPE_DEF division, the minimum of 1, the shield step, the Cover Band redirect and the death flag were read
The caster's ATK at cast time (items, synergies, buffs); only the field read in the strategy was traced
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, target selection before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
unresolved: Whether the Cover Band redirect makes the PP bonus fire for the cover ally's death instead of the cast target's was traced in code (returned value of the redirected call) but not exercised
Whether any item or synergy effect changes GUILLOTINE
Units not listed in appliesTo that might share the identifier are not covered
